title: Ex-German spy chief arrested on espionage and treason charges

paragraphs: August Hanning, who headed the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005 before embarking on a career as a private consultant, has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, the German Federal Prosecutor's Office has announced. Prosecutors allege that he exploited classified intelligence to "draft an analysis" for one foreign intelligence service while simultaneously maintaining contact with another. Investigators have not disclosed which foreign powers were involved.

Police also arrested former BND employee Manfred D, accusing him of passing Hanning approximately 2,000 classified documents in exchange for money. Manfred D, who served as Hanning's bureau chief and remained in the BND until this year, faces charges of aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage. Local media reported that Hanning was apprehended at his home in Nordwalde near Münster, while Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday and Manfred D will appear on Tuesday.

Prosecutors say Manfred D, who also served as chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, leveraged his role to gain access to highly confidential information, which he then passed on to Hanning "in exchange for remuneration". "The current findings suggest that, over the years, Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many of which contained classified information to be used exclusively by the Federal Intelligence Service for internal purposes," the statement says. On one occasion, Hanning used classified intelligence to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service, prosecutors said, noting it was unclear whether "the material reached the intended recipient".

Hanning is also accused of being "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D, for several years". Local media say Hanning's alleged possession of intelligence documents came to light during a separate case relating to German steakhouse heiress Christina Block. Hamburg public prosecutor's office accused Block of orchestrating the kidnapping of her two youngest children in 2023 amid a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping of the children, which he denies. State criminal police officers reportedly discovered an electronic data storage device containing sensitive information including recent BND documents.

It is not the first time the BND has faced similar controversy. A high-ranking German intelligence officer was charged with treason in 2023 for allegedly passing state secrets to Russia. Prosecutors alleged Carsten L shared intelligence about the war in Ukraine and the Wagner mercenary group and received roughly €400,000 ($450,000; £340,000). His trial is ongoing.
paragraphs_zh: 德国联邦检察官办公室宣布，曾于1998年至2005年执掌联邦情报局（BND）、此后转行担任私人顾问的奥古斯特·汉宁因涉嫌间谍、叛国及为外国势力获取机密信息而被捕。检方指控他利用机密情报为一家外国情报机构“起草分析报告”，同时与另一家外国情报机构保持联系。调查人员未透露涉及哪些外国势力。
警方还逮捕了前BND雇员曼弗雷德·D，指控他以金钱为交换向汉宁传递了约2000份机密文件。曼弗雷德·D曾任汉宁的办公室主任，并一直在BND工作至今年，面临协助和教唆未遂叛国及叛国间谍活动的指控。当地媒体报道称，汉宁在明斯特附近的诺德瓦尔德家中被捕，而曼弗雷德·D在巴伐利亚被捕。汉宁将于周三出庭，曼弗雷德·D将于周二出庭。
检方称，曼弗雷德·D还在2012年至2026年间担任汉宁继任者的幕僚长，他利用职务之便获取高度机密信息，然后“以获取报酬为目的”传递给汉宁。声明称：“目前的调查结果表明，多年来，曼弗雷德·D向汉宁提供了约2000份文件，其中许多包含仅供联邦情报局内部使用的机密信息。”检方表示，汉宁曾有一次利用机密情报为一家外国情报机构的官员起草分析报告，并指出尚不清楚“这些材料是否送达了预定接收者”。

汉宁还被指控“与另一家外国情报机构的代表保持密切接触，多年来向对方传递政治信息，部分信息基于曼弗雷德·D提供的材料”。当地媒体称，汉宁涉嫌持有情报文件一事是在另一起与德国牛排连锁店女继承人克里斯蒂娜·布洛克有关的案件中被发现的。汉堡公共检察官办公室指控布洛克在2023年因监护权纠纷策划绑架她两个最小的孩子。调查人员称汉宁参与了更早的一次绑架儿童未遂事件，他对此予以否认。据报道，州刑事警察在调查中发现了一个电子数据存储设备，其中包含敏感信息，包括近期的BND文件。
这并非BND首次面临类似争议。2023年，一名德国高级情报官员因涉嫌向俄罗斯传递国家机密而被控叛国。检方指控卡斯滕·L分享了有关乌克兰战争和瓦格纳雇佣军集团的情报，并收受了约40万欧元（45万美元；34万英镑）。他的审判仍在进行中。
